AgentNode.description: A regular agent node that runs a single named agent and writes output to a context path.

type.description: Node type discriminator. Defaults to 'agent' when omitted.

agent.description: Agent ID from the top-level 'agents' map.

writes.description: Dot-notation context path where the agent's output is stored (e.g. 'output.reply', 'working.intent').

SwrmAgent.description: An inline agent definition within a swrm node.

id.description: Unique agent identifier within the swrm node.

model.description: Model name (e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini', 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'). Provider default used if omitted.

prompt.description: Prompt template sent to the agent. Supports {{ variable }} interpolation.

SwrmSynthesis.description: Optional synthesis step that aggregates swrm agent outputs into a single response.

model.description: Model name. Provider default used if omitted.

prompt.description: Synthesis prompt template. Can reference agent outputs via {{ <node_id>.agents.<agent_id>.output }}.

SwrmNode.description: A swrm (parallel agent fan-out) node. Runs all agents concurrently and optionally synthesises their outputs.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of agents to run concurrently. Defaults to all agents in parallel.

on_failure.description: Policy when an agent fails. 'abort' raises SwrmAgentError; 'continue' skips the failed agent.

agents.description: Ordered list of agents to run in parallel.

synthesis.description: Optional synthesis step. Its output becomes the node's canonical output.

FactoryNode.description: A factory node that dynamically spawns agent instances for each item in a runtime list. The for_each expression resolves to a JSON array; one agent call is made per item. Supports {{ item }} and {{ index }} interpolation inside inputs.

agent.description: Agent ID from the top-level agents map. This agent is instantiated once per list item.

for_each.description: Template expression that resolves to a JSON list at runtime. Example: "{{ plan.output }}". Supports {{ expr }} interpolation.

inputs.description: Template strings for each input key. Supports {{ item }}, {{ index }}, and all other interpolation namespaces.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of agent instances to run concurrently.

timeout_per_instance.description: Per-instance timeout in seconds. Instances exceeding this limit are killed and recorded as errors.

on_failure.description: Policy when an instance fails: 'abort' raises FactoryNodeError; 'continue' records the error and continues.

writes.description: Dot-notation context path where the list of instance outputs is stored (e.g. 'working.execute.outputs').

WorkflowNode.description: A node that executes another SirenSpec workflow inline. The sub-workflow runs blocking; its output dict is written into the parent context keyed by node ID.

ref.description: Relative or absolute file path to a .yaml workflow file (e.g. './workflows/b.yaml'), or a named key in the WorkflowRegistry passed to the executor.

inputs.description: Explicit input bindings for the sub-workflow. Values are template strings resolved against the parent context. Sub-workflows access these via {{ inputs.<key> }}.

writes.description: Optional dot-notation path where sub-workflow output is also written. Defaults to 'output.<node_id>' when omitted.

max_depth.description: Maximum allowed nesting depth. Raises ValidationError if exceeded.

agents.description: Named agent definitions. Keys are agent IDs. Used by regular agent nodes.

system.description: System prompt for this agent. Supports {{ expr }} interpolation against the workflow context.

guardrails.description: Agent-level guardrail overrides. Overrides global guardrails.

nodes.description: Named node definitions. Keys are node IDs. Values are agent nodes, tool nodes, or swrm nodes.

oneOf.description: Tool node: invokes an HTTP endpoint or a Python callable.

type.description: Discriminator that marks this as a tool node.

tool.description: Tool adapter to use: 'http' for HTTP requests, 'python' for Python callable.

url.description: Request URL. Supports template placeholders ({{ expr }}).

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers. Values support template placeholders.

body.description: Optional request body string (used for POST). Supports template placeholders.

function.description: Function name to call on the imported module.

args.description: Keyword arguments passed to the function. Values support template placeholders.

output_key.description: Key under which the tool result is stored in working.<node_id>.<output_key>. Defaults to 'output'.

retry.description: Number of additional retry attempts on failure.

on_failure.description: Behaviour after all retry attempts fail: 'raise' (default) stops execution; 'skip' continues with null output.

when.description: Condition expression evaluated after the source node completes.

input.description: Optional static input for the first node.

guardrails.description: Global guardrails applied to all agents. Defaults to ['injection'] if omitted.
